definition_zh: 断层两侧发生的相对位移。
usage_overview: 在穿越活动断裂带的隧道及轨道结构响应分析中，作为引起结构变形的外部作用；数值模拟可通过施加位移边界条件表示断层两侧的相对运动。

complete_examples.text: Therefore, the track structure is required to have the ability to resist the deformation caused by fault dislocation, so that the safety of train travelling can be ensured by adopting simple engineering measures.

Based on the models, the changes of track geometry of the two track structures were studied, the mechanical behaviour of track compo nents was revealed, and the effect of irregularity caused by fault disloca tion on vehicle dynamic response was studied.
